biology: It seriously damages the timber structure of buildings.
distribution: Mount Daiyun, Mount Wuyi and elsewhere in Fujian.
soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.55–0.59, lateral margins parallel, the middle of the posterior margin straight, posterior lateral corners slightly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised, slightly concave between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the apex thickly needle-shaped with a rather blunt tip, apical and subapical setae present, lateral apical setae very small. Mandibles long and strong, apex rather strongly curved, the outer margin somewhat wavy, mandibular basal ridge visible; length 0.55–0.56 of head capsule length and 0.96 of head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior sixth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal and extending posteriorly, the middle section slightly concave; waist region slender and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.27–0.32. Pronotum trapezoidal, about 1.51–1.64 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, both with a shallow incision in the middle; 4–6 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
